item.name: [LG-EX-03] P6: response login không chứa chuỗi "password" ở bất kỳ đâu

exec: pm.test("[LG-EX-03] setup: đăng ký email status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));

const g=(o,p)=>pm.variables.replaceIn(p).split('.').reduce((a,k)=>{if(a==null)return undefined;const m=k.match(/^\[(\w+)=(.*)\]$/);return m?(Array.isArray(a)?a.find(x=>x&&String(x[m[1]])===m[2]):undefined):a[k];},o);
let j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { j = {}; }
pm.collectionVariables.set("uid", g(j, "id"));
pm.collectionVariables.set("email", pm.variables.replaceIn("lg-{{$guid}}@test.com"));
pm.test("[LG-EX-03] status 200", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("[LG-EX-03] core: body không chứa \"password\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include("\"password\""));
